content: ⌊ DRAFT g Mapping between a DiagnosticFunctionIden- tifier and a CpSoftwareClusterResource The creation of a mapping between a DiagnosticFunctionIdentifier and a CpSoftwareClusterResource by means of a CpSwClusterResourceToDiagFunctionIdMapping supports the configuration of the transport of the execution permission associated with a Diag- nosticFunctionIdentifier across the boundaries of a CpSoftwareCluster .
